name: 42224-visionchat-10b-1gpu
model: stepfun-ai/Step3-VL-10B. Ungated, apache-2.0, ~20.4 GB of bf16 safetensors in 5 shards.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine (`--distributed-executor-backend uni`, no worker subprocess).
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate=5 req/s, warmup 13%, no cooldown, bounded at 230 requests with a 300 s safety cap; the scored window is about 46 s of wall clock.
workload: single-turn image chat: two distinct 400x400 jpeg images plus a 128-token prompt per request, 4 output tokens. The image geometry is not a free parameter -- this checkpoint's preprocessing is size-dependent, so another size is another workload.
purpose: A single-turn visual chat assistant taking two small images plus a short prompt, five requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM engine arguments. The engine build itself is named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`.

model: stepfun-ai/Step3-VL-10B

# REQUIRED: this checkpoint's config.json declares a `model_type` this engine's config registry
# does not know, and carries an `auto_map`. Without this the config cannot be loaded at all.
trust-remote-code: true

max-model-len: 8192
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

distributed-executor-backend: uni
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The two structured values below MUST each stay on ONE line -- the engine reads this file line
# by line and skips indented ones, so re-flowing either into a block mapping drops the key and
# the engine starts without it at rc=0.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 2, "video": 0}

dtype: bfloat16

enable-prefix-caching: false

# The explicit token budgets are load-bearing: left to the default the range runs to
# `max-num-batched-tokens` and the engine does not fit in 80 GB and fails at startup.
compilation-config: {"cudagraph_mm_encoder": true, "encoder_cudagraph_token_budgets": [338, 1536], "encoder_cudagraph_max_vision_items_per_batch": 2}
